components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard action button with emerald fill and subtle hover lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #059669; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #047857; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost or subtle secondary action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e2e8f0; border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped toggle button for categories and datasets.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { background: #f1f5f9; color: #475569; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background: #e2e8f0; color: #0f172a; } .ds-filter-chip.ds-filter-chip-active { background: #059669; color: #ffffff; } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Compendium Card
components.description: Topic showcase vitrine card with hairline border and soft lift.
components.html:
Clinical Medicine

STEMI & ACS Diagnostic Pathway

Interactive ECG decision tree for acute coronary syndrome triage under ESC/AHA protocols.
components.css: .ds-compendium-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04); transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-compendium-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08); border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-card-category { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #059669; margin-bottom: 8px; display: block; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #475569; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: LoLyeah Compendium bridges rigorous academic literature, clinical medicine, macroeconomic policy, and physical sciences with high-craft digital editorial design. It rejects sterile SaaS templates, generic corporate dashboards, and frivolous decorative animations in favor of a calm, intentional, topic-led digital publication.
keyCharacteristics: Topic-Led Form: Visual motifs, diagrams, and color treatments emerge directly from the subject matter.
Cognitive Clarity: Dense compendiums remain navigable through disciplined typographic hierarchy, generous line heights, and compact progressive disclosure.
Craft Floor Discipline: 100% free of cheap generative UI patterns—no kicker labels, no gradient text, no raw emoji icons, and no zero-blur drop shadows.

rules.name: The Scarcity Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used on ≤ 10% of any given surface. Its rarity and restraint are what make interactive points immediately legible.

rules.name: The No-Gray-on-Tint Rule
rules.body: On colored or darkroom surfaces, secondary text is tinted directly from the foreground or backing hue—never washed-out flat gray.

rules.name: The Data-Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace is strictly reserved for data, numbers, formulas, and code. It is never used as an aesthetic body font.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose must never exceed 75 characters per line (max-width: 75ch) to maintain optimal ocular tracking.

rules.name: The Single Elevation Rule
rules.body: Declare elevation once: either a clean 1px hairline border or an ambient blurred shadow. Never stack thick colored borders on top of heavy shadows.

dos: Do let headings speak for themselves; use confident typographic scale instead of kickers or eyebrows.
Do provide defensible defaults and clear intermediate math for all interactive calculators.
Do ensure every interactive element meets WCAG 2.2 AA (4.5:1 contrast, 44×44px touch targets).
Do honor @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) by disabling non-essential transitions while preserving instant feedback.
Do theme native browser surfaces (scrollbars, selection, focus indicators).
donts: Don't use gradient text or rainbow fills.
Don't use raw emojis in functional buttons, tabs, or badges—use authored SVGs.
Don't use monospace as a decorative body font.
Don't use zero-blur hard block shadows outside deliberate neobrutalism.
Don't build interactive widgets without a written widget contract and accessible fallback.
